effects.issue: The finite AnnounceNumber UI accepts an explicit option list and has no unrestricted integer-entry prompt. Enumerating every integer from 1 to LP-1 is not a supported/practical Omega selection, so the Lua currently offers 100-LP increments plus LP-1. Resolution: change 'any amount' to 'any amount in multiples of 100 (or all but 1 LP)', or add an integer-range prompt to Omega and use it in c217332244.lua.
